acceptance_scope: Complete selected kernel-only delivery under the stated ideal Real and one fixed scalar/conversion/SM80-instruction interpretation, with actual Tensor coordinate observations and source/word-address frames. This review does not claim a unified final byteheap, GPU execution, universal compiler conformance or native-to-Real accuracy.
conclusion: No actionable source, proof, admission, Tensor-binding or evidence defect was found in the assigned scope. Complete successful quoted-source execution is derived on an evolving state for every full-grid permutation. Independent mathematical and state-free native targets are connected to actual output coordinates and frames. The native endpoint fixes one instruction interpretation and does not rely on the retained historical transport or whole-result hypotheses.

mixed_precision_review.QK: FP32 Q/K loads, active D96 zero padded to D128, default TF32 QK lowering as sixteen zero-seeded fixed K8 MMA lane steps, FP32 result.
mixed_precision_review.scales: Two ordered FP32 score multiplications. Saved N129 PTX first multiplies QK by query scale and then multiplies key scale by that intermediate; Native.lower preserves that observed operand order explicitly.
mixed_precision_review.normalization: FP32 maxNum, exp2ApproxFTZ, source m=-inf/l=1 seeds, four owner replicas, sixteen local ordered reduction values, xor2 then xor1 exchanges, and every live online block/tail remain in the native graph.
mixed_precision_review.PV: P and V explicitly narrow to FP16. PV uses four zero-seeded fixed K16 instructions with FP16 accumulation/output, not FP32 PV accumulation. The half result widens to FP32 before the online accumulator update.
mixed_precision_review.final: The FP32 online normalizer/accumulator update uses the declared fused lowering; final div.full.f32 is followed by BF16 narrowing. Saved PTX contains f16-output MMA, cvt.f32.f16, fma.rn.f32, div.full.f32 and cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32 in the inspected route.
mixed_precision_review.ports: Thirteen families cover scalar operations, conversions and a single coordinate of literal m16n8k8 TF32 or m16n8k16 half-output MMA. No variable-K whole-dot, row reduction, output tensor or result callback is a public premise. Historical LocalTransport results are preserved but unused by the new endpoint.
mixed_precision_review.interpretation_boundary: Instruction semantics and applicability of this fixed graph to actual compiler output are explicit model boundaries. Saved profiles include compiler specialization, especially N=1 dead lanes; the packet does not claim universal bitwise equality to every specialization or architecture. No native-to-Real identity or finite-input restriction is introduced.

All five saved nonempty profiles compile; three empty profiles capture no launch. This is not an actual CUDA launch trace.

Manual inspection additionally confirmed representative scale operand order, local max reduction, half-result widening, live FMA update and final BF16 conversion.

They verify exact BF16 output 2, complete tested input backing frames and unused-M preservation. They are source controls on simple exact values, not native instruction conformance experiments.
evidence_review.resources: Saved metadata reports 98304 or 131076 shared bytes per CTA. Resource availability and native runtime success are explicitly external; no GPU execution is claimed.
